user.title: Connect to the LifeMiles watcher
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running the watcher app (it serves the status at http://HOST:PORT/status.json). The token is optional: it lets this integration change which routes are searched.

data_description.api_token: The watcher's WATCH_API_TOKEN. Leave empty to only read the status.

reconfigure.title: Change the watcher connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address, or add the token that switches route editing on.

data_description.api_token: The watcher's WATCH_API_TOKEN. Leave empty to only read the status.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the watcher at that address.
error.invalid_response: That address answered, but it is not a LifeMiles watcher.
error.invalid_host: Enter only the host name or IP address, without http:// or a path.
error.read_only: The watcher has no token set (WATCH_API_TOKEN), so routes cannot be edited. Set it on the watcher, or leave the token empty here.
error.watcher_outdated: That watcher is too old to edit routes. Update it first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This watcher is already set up.

init.title: Watched routes
init.description: Changes apply at the watcher's next daily batch.

add.title: Add a route
add.description:
Every airport in From is searched to every airport in To, one way, for each date in the range. Pick from the list or type any 3-letter airport code.

{details}

data_description.return_start: Fill both return dates to also search the same airports in the opposite direction.

remove.title: Remove routes
remove.description: Choose the routes to stop watching. Their availability leaves "Available now" and moves to the history.

reset.title: Reset the routes
reset.description: Stop using the list saved from Home Assistant and go back to the routes in the watcher's config.toml.

error.return_dates: Fill in both return dates, or neither.
error.invalid_watches: The watcher rejected this route. See the reasons above.

abort.no_token: Routes can only be edited with the watcher's token. Add it with Reconfigure on the integration.
abort.watcher_read_only: The watcher has no token set (WATCH_API_TOKEN), so it is read-only.
abort.watcher_outdated: That watcher is too old to edit routes. Update it first.
abort.invalid_auth: The watcher rejected the token. Update it with Reconfigure on the integration.
